title: Flower Guard
brief: Ants and armoured beetles crawl in from every edge toward a flower; tap them to squash them (beetles take three taps). Survive four waves to win; four bites wilt the flower.

title: Mirror Knight
brief: Slide a knight's shield along the bottom to bounce a dragon's fireballs back into it, aiming with where they hit the shield. Twelve hits drive the dragon off; three fireballs landing on the village lose.

title: Slingshot Squirrel
brief: The squirrel's pouch charges from acorn to chestnut to a piercing coconut while you wait; tap the sky to fling the loaded nut at pinecone-dropping crows. Down ten crows to win, three bonks lose.

title: Pirate Broadside
brief: Drag a brig up and down while its cannon fires on its own at galleons sailing in, but never hit the white merchant ships. Sink twelve galleons to win; lose three lives to grapeshot, rams or raiders slipping past.

title: Snowball Fort
brief: Tap the snow pile to pack snowballs and tap the sky to throw them at rival kids who pop up behind their wall, while their iceballs wear down your fort. Fifteen hits win, three hits on you lose.

title: Wizard Duel
brief: Two duelling rounds: tap the bolt rune to spend mana on bolts and the ward rune for a barrier, against an apprentice and then a blinking archmage. Drain both rivals to win; three hits lose.

title: Lighthouse Keeper
brief: Sea creatures swim at the lighthouse along the four compass lines; tap an arrow to fire a beam of light that way, each beam burning slowly refilling oil. Last until dawn to win; three creatures reaching the tower lose.

title: Hive Defender
brief: Steer a bee with the joystick while it fires homing stingers at wasps raiding the hive and dodges hornets that hunt it; hornets drop honey that repairs the hive. Survive every wave to win; lose if the hive or the bee runs out.

title: Pumpkin Patrol
brief: Flying saucers hover over the county fair and dive to beam up prize pumpkins; slide the farmer whose corn popper fires on its own, and shoot loaded saucers to drop the pumpkin back. Down fifteen saucers to win; lose all four pumpkins and it is over.

title: Ghost Lantern
brief: Drag a lantern whose light pulses banish ghosts, but only while they are visible, since they keep fading in and out; wraiths hunt you even when faded. Banish twenty spirits to win, three hits lose.

title: Siege Catapult
brief: Every rock flies the same arc, so you aim by sliding the catapult around its yard and tap the sky to throw, while arrows rain back. Topple the wooden fort, then the stone keep behind a moving palisade, to win; four arrow hits lose.

title: Duckling Escort
brief: A duckling waddles a winding trail to the pond; drag a spitting frog to shoot or gulp the mosquitoes and beetles that chase it. Get the duckling to the pond to win; three bites send it running home.

title: Junkyard Titan
brief: Fly a little mech under a scrap-metal giant: break both claws to crack open its shielded core, then pound the core through two angrier phases with missiles and repair bots. Destroy the core to win, five hits lose.

title: Storm Bosses
brief: Drag a paper plane and tap the sky to fire from a refilling ammo bar against three weather bosses in turn: a lightning cloud, a gusting twister and a hail king with ice-slab walls. Beat all three to win, five hits lose.

title: Bathtub Admiral
brief: A rubber duck squirts its way through soap bubbles that split, sponge subs and toy sharks, powering up to a piercing torpedo, until the Drain Kraken rises. Defeat the kraken to win; lose all lives or let eight bubbles overflow the tub.
